text: (1)Foreign citizens holding foreign passports;(2)The physical health condition meets the medical examination requirements for visaapplication stipulated by the National lmmigration Administration;(3) Age not exceeding 25 years old;(4)Having a high school diploma or equivalent educational background;(5)For subjects and majors that use English as the language of instruction, non-nativeEnglish speaking applicants must achieve an English proficiency level of IELTS 6.0 Or TOEFL69. Applicants without an English proficiency certificate must provide a 3-minute Englishlanguage video;(6)Students are required to undergo an interview organized by the school during theapplication process (which can be done remotely).
